title: Repair
description:
You restore a piece of equipment you are touching that is {{brise}} or has lost some of its {{encaissement}}.

Commit materials that cover each Type in its recipe and whose Material Values add up to half its cost or more, rounded up. A material counts for only one of its Types. The materials are used up as soon as you commit them.

Then make the last {{jet}} of its recipe, with the {{caracteristique}} and {{dd}} it gives and the recipe's discipline as the {{aptitude}}. On a success, the piece is no longer {{brise}} and gets all its {{encaissement}} back. On a failure, the materials are lost.

For a piece whose entry prints no recipe, the GM sets the Types, the cost and the {{jet}} of the repair.
